item.title: CELTIC IN £3m LINK
item.description: CELTIC have been linked with £3million-rated Norwegian midfielder Felix Horn Myhre. Martin O’Neill has until a week today to strengthen his squad as the clock ticks down towards the signing deadline. item.title: WATCH AGAIN: CELTIC’S CAPITAL STRIKES
item.description: BENJAMIN NYGREN flashed in an unstoppable free-kick for his thirteenth goal of the season in Celtic’s 2-2 draw with Hearts at Tynecastle yesterday. Unfortunately, the hosts drew level shortly after the turnaround with a header from former Hoops prospect Stuart Findlay. item.description: Just as in Bologna on Thursday, Celtic’s passing during the opening exchanges was excellent. item.title: ‘I’M HERE,’ McGREGOR DISMISSES RODGERS REPORTS
item.description: CALLUM McGREGOR has dismissed speculation linking the Celtic skipper with a reunion with Brendan Rodgers in Saudi Arabia. Reports have suggested the 32-year-old midfielder could follow the former Hoops boss to Saudi Pro League outfit Al-Qadsiah. However, McGregor, who is under contract until June 2028, insisted he has no intention of making such a move [...]

item.description: DAVID DICKINSON will be in charge of Celtic’s Premiership encounter against Falkirk at Parkhead on Sunday. item.title: ALEX’S ANGLE: BEATON + VAR = RED CARD FOR CELTIC
item.description: AUSTON TRUSTY became the first Celtic player to be red-carded in 86 domestic games when he was dismissed at Tynecastle on Sunday. item.title: CELTIC’S £1.5m MISFIT ON MOVE
item.description: CELTIC’S £1.5million misfit striker Shin Yamada has agreed a short-term loan deal with German second-tie club Preussen Munster.
